'''Yannick Lapointe Bring Him Before Me DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-15704">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15704 DeckTech post 15704], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 2 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15704/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15704/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Yannick Lapointe]]
* '''Published:''' 2 May 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 BHBM Lapointe DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits the one that make WYS look stupid, grabbler: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' Yeah

== Original post ==

'''They took a photo of Uranus-QC champ S-H-I-T'''
* '''Author:''' Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe
* '''Published:''' May 2, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Yeah

=== Strategy ===

this deck have HUGE destiny

remember tie bomber squad have destiny 7

and you always draw 2 to 4 destiny in battle

this deck is a beat stick

i dont care if you rate this low, because of the strategy....iam not posting this so you can learn how to play and get better, iam posting this because i just want to show what i have play

if you think this deck is @#$%, it is maybe because you are a scrub

Yannick ”2001 World Champion” Lapointe
